text: “Badaa” jechuun “kan gaarii hin taane” jechuudha. Qubee “d” yoo dachaa goote, “baddaa” maal ta'a?
gloss: “Badaa” means “not good”. If you double the “d”, what does “baddaa” become? — Cool highland: consonant length changes the word; baddaa (highland) is the opposite of gammoojjii (lowland).

text: Hima “Caaltuun ganama buna …” keessatti jechi bakka duwwaa sirriitti guutu kami?
gloss: In “Chaltu drank coffee in the morning”, which word correctly fills the gap? — Dhugde: Chaltu is a woman, so the verb takes the feminine -t- (dhug- + -te → dhugde). Dhuge is masculine, dhugne “we”, dhugan “they”.

text: Jechi “torbaan” (guyyoota walitti aanan) maqaa lakkoofsa kam irraa dhufe?
gloss: The word “torbaan” (a run of consecutive days, a week) comes from which number? — Torba (seven): a week is seven days.

text: Afaan Oromootiin obboleessi haadha keetii maal jedhama?
gloss: In Oromo, what is your mother's brother called? — Eessuma. Abbeeraa is the father's sister, adaadaa the mother's sister, akaakayyuu the grandfather.

text: Yeroon abaaboon daraaree Irreechi itti kabajamu maal jedhama?
gloss: What is the season when flowers bloom and Irreecha is celebrated called? — Birraa (Sept–Nov, after the rains). Bona is the dry season, Arfaasaa the small rains, Ganna the main rains.

text: Sirna buna aadaa keessatti, okkoteen suphee irraa hojjetamee buni keessatti danfu maal jedhama?
gloss: In the traditional coffee ceremony, what is the clay pot the coffee boils in called? — Jabanaa. Sinii are the small cups, ciicoo a milk container, gabatee a bowl.

text: Gareen kubbaa miilaa biyyoolessaa Itoophiyaa maqaa bineensa kamiin waamama?
gloss: Ethiopia's national football team is called after which animal? — The Walia (ibex): the team is known as the Walias. Lion, elephant and buffalo are the distractors.

text: Sirna Gadaa keessatti yaa'iin ummataa yeroo baay'ee muka kam jala taa'a?
gloss: In the Gadaa system, under which tree does the people's assembly usually sit? — The Odaa (sycamore fig), the symbol of Gadaa assemblies.

text: Meeshaan muuziqaa aadaa “dibbee” jedhamu akkamitti taphatama?
gloss: How is the traditional instrument “dibbee” played? — By beating it: the dibbee is a drum. Blowing, shaking and plucking are the distractors.

text: Akka durdurii beekamaatti, humna bunaa jalqaba kan agarsiise horii kami?
gloss: According to the well-known legend, which livestock first showed the energising power of coffee? — Goats: the herder (Kaldi in the legend) saw his goats lively after eating coffee berries.

text: Akka kaalaandarii Itoophiyaatti waggaan tokko ji'oota meeqa qaba?
gloss: By the Ethiopian calendar, how many months has a year? — 13: twelve of 30 days plus Pagume of 5 (6 in a leap year).

text: Itoophiyaan galaana hin qabdu. Meeshaa alaa baay'ina isaa buufata doonii biyya kamii fayyadamtee galchiti?
gloss: Ethiopia has no sea. Through which country's port does it bring in most of its imports? — Djibouti, which handles the great majority of Ethiopia's trade.

text: Dhugaatiin aadaa damma fi bishaan irraa tolfamee bilchaatu maal jedhama?
gloss: What is the traditional drink fermented from honey and water called? — Daadhii (mead, tej). Farsoo is home beer, araqee a distilled spirit, itittuu soured milk.

text: Lakkoofsa bilbilaa idil-addunyaa irratti koodiin biyyaa Itoophiyaa kami?
gloss: In international phone numbers, what is Ethiopia's country code? — +251. +254 is Kenya, +252 Somalia, +253 Djibouti.

text: Tajaajilli Itiyoo Telekoom maallaqa bilbilaan erguu fi kaffaluuf oolu maal jedhama?
gloss: What is Ethio Telecom's service for sending and paying money by phone called? — telebirr (2021). M-Pesa is Safaricom's, CBE Birr the Commercial Bank's.

text: Warshaaleen sukkaaraa akka Wonjii sukkaara biqiltuu kamii irraa oomishu?
gloss: From which plant do sugar factories such as Wonji make sugar? — Sugarcane (shonkora). Maize, wheat and banana are the distractors.

text: Appiin ergaa mallattoo xiyyaara waraqaa irraa hojjetame qabu kami?
gloss: Which messaging app has a paper-plane logo? — Telegram, hugely popular in Ethiopia.

text: Kaappuchiinoo gochuuf buna espresso irratti maaltu dabalama?
gloss: What is added to an espresso to make a cappuccino? — Steamed, frothed milk. Hot water gives an americano.

text: Asoosama “Things Fall Apart” kan barreesse barreessaan Naayijeeriyaa eenyu?
gloss: Which Nigerian writer wrote the novel “Things Fall Apart”? — Chinua Achebe (1958). Soyinka is also Nigerian (Nobel 1986, a playwright); Ngũgĩ is Kenyan, Dangarembga Zimbabwean.

text: Mallattoon daandii qubee “P” guddaa qabu maal agarsiisa?
gloss: What does a road sign with a big letter “P” show? — A parking place. Police station, fuel station and pedestrian crossing are the distractors.

text: Bishaan okkotee keessaa dafee akka danfuuf maal gochuu qabda?
gloss: What should you do so the water in a pot boils sooner? — Cover it with a lid: less heat escapes. Salt slightly raises the boiling point; more water or a lower flame slow it down.

text: Fiigichi maaratoonii dheerinni isaa gara kiiloomeetira meeqaa?
gloss: About how many kilometres long is a marathon? — 42 (42.195 km). 21 is the half marathon.

text: Fiilmii “Black Panther” keessatti biyyi Afrikaa mootummaa T'Chaallaa maal jedhamti?
gloss: In the film “Black Panther”, what is T'Challa's African kingdom called? — Wakanda. Zamunda is from “Coming to America”, Genovia from “The Princess Diaries”, Narnia from C. S. Lewis.

text: Weellisaan reegee beekamaan Bob Marley biyya kam irraa ture?
gloss: Which country was the famous reggae singer Bob Marley from? — Jamaica. Cuba, Haiti and Barbados are neighbouring Caribbean countries.

text: Sabbanni Waaqaa samii irratti akka mul'atuuf, aduu malee maaltu barbaachisa?
gloss: For a rainbow (“Waaqa's belt”) to appear in the sky, what is needed besides the Sun? — Raindrops, which split sunlight into colours.

text: Yeroo ho'aa ykn sochii cimaa booda qaamni keenya maaliif dafqa?
gloss: Why does our body sweat in hot weather or after hard exercise? — To cool the body: sweat evaporating takes heat away.

text: Gaarri Kiliimanjaaroo biyya kam keessa argama?
gloss: Which country is Mount Kilimanjaro in? — Tanzania, close to the Kenyan border (Kenya is the trap: the mountain is often seen from there).

text: Taaksiin tokko namoota afur qofa fe'a. Namoota kudhan geessuuf taaksii meeqatu barbaachisa?
gloss: A taxi carries only four people. How many taxis are needed to take ten people? — 3: 10 ÷ 4 = 2.5, and half a taxi doesn't exist, so round up.

text: Weedduun dhiironni goota faarsuuf ykn of jajuuf sagalee guddaan dhiyeessan maal jedhama?
gloss: What is the chant men deliver in a loud voice to praise heroes or boast of their own deeds called? — Geerarsa. Hiibboo are riddles, mammaaksa proverbs, shaggooyyee a dance song.

text: Manneen kiristaanaa Laalibalaa kanneen jaarraa 12ffaa–13ffaa maaliin addaa ta'u?
gloss: What makes the 12th–13th-century churches of Lalibela special? — They are carved out of the rock itself, not built up from wood, clay or metal.

text: Weellisni Shakiraa “Waka Waka” Waancaa Addunyaa biyya kamitti qophaa'eef?
gloss: Shakira's song “Waka Waka” was made for the World Cup held in which country? — South Africa (2010). Germany 2006, Russia 2018, Qatar 2022.

text: Teessoo marsariitii jalqaba irratti “https” keessatti qubeen “s” maal agarsiisa?
gloss: In “https” at the start of a web address, what does the letter “s” show? — A secure (encrypted) connection; it says nothing about speed or who owns the site.

text: Antibaayotikiin qufaa fi ifluweenzaa vaayirasiin dhufu maaliif hin fayyisu?
gloss: Why don't antibiotics cure a cold or flu caused by a virus? — They don't kill viruses: antibiotics act on bacteria.

text: Hanqaaquun bishaan keessa yoo buufamu bololi'e, kun maal agarsiisa?
gloss: If an egg floats when put in water, what does it show? — That it is old: its air pocket grows with age. A fresh egg sinks.

text: Awurooppaa keessatti mukni kutame geengoo 30 qaba. Umuriin isaa gara meeqa?
gloss: In Europe, a felled tree shows 30 rings. About how old is it? — 30 years: in a climate with one cold season a tree adds one ring a year.

text: “Barataa” baay'inaan “barattoota” ta'a. Akkasuma “hojjetaa” baay'inaan maal ta'a?
gloss: “Barataa” (student) becomes “barattoota” in the plural. Likewise, what is the plural of “hojjetaa” (worker)? — Hojjettoota: the same -aa → -toota pattern, as in “hojjettoota mootummaa” (civil servants).

text: Sirni aadaa Oromoo jaarsoliin waldhabdee namootaa araaraan itti furan maal jedhama?
gloss: What is the Oromo custom in which elders settle people's disputes by reconciliation called? — Jaarsummaa. Moggaasa is adoption into a clan, Buttaa a Gadaa feast, Ateetee a women's rite.

text: Biyyoota Afrikaa keessaa baay'ina ummataatiin kan tokkoffaa ta'e kami?
gloss: Which African country has the largest population? — Nigeria (over 220 million); Ethiopia, the trap, is second.

text: Akka seenaa durii Itoophiyaatti, Mootittiin Saabaa Yerusaalemitti mootii kam daawwatte?
gloss: In the Ethiopian tradition, which king did the Queen of Sheba visit in Jerusalem? — Solomon (the Kebra Nagast; also 1 Kings 10). David was his father.

text: Waancaan Addunyaa bara 2022 Qaxaritti qophaa'e. Inni itti aanu bara kam qophaa'e?
gloss: The World Cup was held in Qatar in 2022. In which year was the next one held? — 2026: the World Cup comes every four years (USA, Canada, Mexico).

text: Kartuunii “SpongeBob SquarePants” keessatti SpongeBob galaana jalatti mana akkamii keessa jiraata?
gloss: In the cartoon “SpongeBob SquarePants”, what kind of house does SpongeBob live in under the sea? — A pineapple.

text: Qubee Afaan Oromoo keessatti, qubeen “x” akka jecha “xiqqaa” keessatti sagalee fidal kamii bakka bu'a?
gloss: In the Oromo Qubee alphabet, which fidal sound does the letter “x” stand for, as in “xiqqaa” (small)? — ጠ, the ejective t'. Qubee uses x for it, as it uses q for ቀ and c for ጨ.

text: Holqi beekamaan Soof Umar Oromiyaa naannoo kam keessatti argama?
gloss: In which part of Oromia is the famous Sof Omar cave? — Bale, carved by the Weyb river. Its Muslim shrine traditions make Hararghe a tempting guess.

text: Sheek Bakrii Saphaloo, beekaa fi barreessaan Oromoo, keessattuu maaliin yaadatama?
gloss: What is Sheikh Bakri Sapalo, the Oromo scholar and writer, remembered for above all? — Creating a writing system for Oromo (1950s). Translating the Bible was Onesimos Nesib's work.

text: Fiigicha meetira 10,000 dirree meetira 400 irratti, fiigaan marsaa meeqa fiiga?
gloss: In a 10,000 m race on a 400 m track, how many laps does the runner run? — 25: 10,000 ÷ 400.

text: Gosti dhiigaa nama gosa dhiigaa kamiifuu kennamuu danda'u kami?
gloss: Which blood type can be given to a person of any blood type? — O negative, the universal red-cell donor. AB+ is the universal recipient, the trap.

text: Bara 1953 Edmund Hillary waliin jalqaba fiixee Gaara Everest kan ga'e eenyu?
gloss: Who first reached the summit of Everest with Edmund Hillary in 1953? — Tenzing Norgay. Mallory vanished in 1924, Tabei was the first woman (1975), Messner the first without oxygen.

text: Daandiin baaburaa Finfinnee fi Jibuutii bara 1917 xumurame dhaabbata biyya kamiin ijaarame?
gloss: The Addis Ababa–Djibouti railway, completed in 1917, was built by a company from which country? — France (the Franco-Ethiopian railway).

text: Afawarq Takla fakkii foddaa calaqqisaa isaa beekamaa gamoo kamii keessatti hojjete?
gloss: In which building did Afewerk Tekle make his famous stained-glass windows? — Africa Hall in Addis Ababa (1961), home of the UN Economic Commission for Africa.

text: Lusii (Dinqinash), bara 1974 Hadaar keessatti argamte, gosa namaa durii kam keessatti ramadamti?
gloss: Lucy (Dinkinesh), found at Hadar in 1974, belongs to which early human species? — Australopithecus afarensis, named after the Afar region. Ardipithecus ramidus (“Ardi”) was also found in Ethiopia, the trap.
